instructions.title: How to use ROT13 / Caesar Cipher

steps.title: Choose a mode
steps.description: Select ROT13 for one-click encoding/decoding, Caesar encode/decode with a custom shift, or brute-force to see all 25 possible rotations at once.

steps.title: Enter your text
steps.description: Paste or type your text into the input area. Letters are rotated; digits, punctuation, spaces and unicode characters pass through unchanged.

steps.title: Pick a shift (Caesar modes only)
steps.description: For encode or decode mode, choose a shift from 1 to 25. ROT13 is fixed at 13 — its own inverse, so the same operation encodes and decodes.

steps.title: Process and copy
steps.description: Click Process (or Show all 25 rotations). Copy the output to your clipboard, or use the output as new input to chain operations.
